thesis_health.reason: Fed and BOJ evidence preserves a positive rate differential and gradual-normalization regime; one week of resident foreign-security selling does not establish structural repatriation.

scenarios.description: Weak yen, gradual BOJ, corporate reform, and company execution reinforce.
Macro support remains, but company quality and valuation determine returns.
exit_conditions: Multiple bull or bear triggers align

scenarios.description: Yen reversal combines with weaker earnings and insufficient valuation support.

decision.summary: Keep broad JPY exposure unchanged and complete Nintendo's post-earnings integrated deep dive before promoting any named opportunity.

developments.evidence: The FOMC held the federal funds target at 3.50%-3.75%; three voters preferred a 25 bp hike.
The BOJ held after the June increase to about 1.0%; a proposal for 1.25% failed. Wages remain firm while reported general-services inflation recently eased to 1.0%-1.5%.
For the week ended July 25, residents bought 320.2 billion yen of foreign equities/funds but sold 811.4 billion yen of long-term foreign debt and 41.1 billion yen of short-term foreign debt.
MOF reported zero foreign-exchange intervention from June 29 through July 29.
Toyota reported 10.4% revenue growth and lower operating income, raised its outlook, and announced a buyback; operating evidence remains mixed.

scorecard.reason: Fed held at 3.50%-3.75% and three voters preferred a hike.
July hold after June hike; wages firm, services inflation softer, one failed hawkish proposal.
Positive U.S.-Japan 2Y and 10Y sovereign differentials persist; direct volatility and hedge-cost confirmation remains incomplete.
MOF reported zero intervention for June 29-July 29.
No verified systemic funding stress; geopolitical and AI concentration risks remain.
Latest week showed net foreign-security selling by residents, but the durable multi-period repatriation threshold was not met.
TSE cost-of-capital implementation continues; quality must be verified company by company.

scorecard.driver: Selected companies remain attractive independent of FX
scorecard.reason: Fresh operating evidence is mixed and normalized valuations are incomplete.

catalysts.evidence: Fed held and three dissents favored tightening.
BOJ held after June hike; wage-price evidence is not uniformly hawkish.
MOF monthly intervention total was zero.
One week of net resident foreign-security selling; confirmation requires multiple periods.
Company results are mixed; Nintendo Q1 is due August 6.

publication.headline: JPY Thesis Remains Intact, but Repatriation Needs Watching
publication.summary: Fed and BOJ policy preserve the fair/selective regime. One week of Japanese resident foreign-security selling is a watch item, not a structural reversal.
